entities.name: Abu Sulayman Banakati
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Sulayman Banakati, was a historian and poet, who lived during the late Ilkhanate era. He is principally known for his Persian world history book, the Rawdat uli al-albab fi maʿrifat al-tawarikh wa al-ansab, better known as Tarikh-i Banakati.
